posts.title: EU seeks up to $55B for AI and quantum computing fund: Report
posts.description: Hackers already use AI to target crypto exchanges, while future quantum computers could break the cryptography that protects users’ funds.

posts.title: South Korea’s crypto bill could move stablecoin race beyond token issuance
posts.description: South Korea’s draft bill favors bank-led stablecoin issuance but allows fintech and technology companies to become the largest individual shareholders.

posts.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
posts.description: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.
